BytePlus Growth Analysis DataFinder provides you with a SaaS version based on BytePlus cloud\-native version \- Finder SaaS\-cloud\-native version. This article is for your SaaS\-cloud native version, the preparatory operations that need to be completed by the administrator role, as well as the operation guidance of subsequent analysts and developers, to help you quickly start the journey of growth analysis data!

<span id="_1-概述"></span>
# Usage flow

In the SaaS cloud native version, creating and connecting projects is a necessary step, and the overall process is as follows:

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="_3-如何接入-创建项目"></span>
# Step 1: Access & Create Project

<span id="接入项目"></span>
## Access project

If you have already created a project and need to integrate the Finder into this project, you can follow the steps below.


1. Click the "**Access New Project**" button in the item switch drop\-down box of the navigation bar to enter the item access page.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/8c8160c1f40c4fcea756ca3b266e9188~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

2. Select the project to be accessed according to the interface prompts, and configure parameters such as project administrator.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/942cd06e0a9c4b458d1632cef497a949~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   Of which:

   * **Project basic information** : If you have not created a good project, you can click **Create New Project** , enter the access control page to create a project, and then access the project.

   * **Data information** : **Specify project criteria ID** currently only supports the use of **ssid** , that is, using ssid as the project criteria. Ssid is a unique ID automatically generated by the system. For details, please refer to documentation.

   * **Application information** : If the project you access has clear applications to be analyzed later, you can create applications while accessing the project. You can also create the application type of the project content after the project is connected. See the **Creating an Application** section below.


<span id="创建项目"></span>
## (Optional) Create a project

If you don't have a project already created, you need to create a project before accessing it.


1. Enter Access Control to create a new project.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/773dd62d229b492fb2927de6d5bc394c~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e5c844f8017a4ca8961d5d5081729abe~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   1. After clicking **Create New Project** , go to the Access Control page and click **New Project** to start creating a new project.

   2. Configure parameters such as the project name according to the interface prompts, and click OK after completion to complete the project creation.

2. After the creation is complete, return to the Finder access project page and click the refresh button to refresh the project list and get the required projects.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/19960a79a3dc4067a1bfe737cd79a7d1~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


<span id="_5-如何绑定-创建应用"></span>
# Step 2: Create the app

Follow the interface prompts to configure the newly created application information.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9acb39c43313494d9bc449c614ac11e0~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

Of which:


* **Analytics principals** : When you have only purchased a growth analytics product, there is only one "default principal" to choose from; when you have purchased a "customer data platform" product at the same time, you can configure multiple principals within it and choose here.

* **Estimated DAU magnitude** : Simple estimation can be made based on the business situation of the current application.


You can view the corresponding project details and the list of applications connected to the project in the Finder's **Project Center** \> **Project Details** page.

<span id="_6-如何给应用接入数据"></span>
# Follow\-up: Access data \- developer


* After the project is created, it will directly enter the **project center** \> **project details** page, where the application can be accessed with data.

* Click "Access Data", the application information (application ID, APP Key, etc.) required for access will be displayed in the pop\-up sidebar, you can also click the corresponding access platform to jump to the " Data Access " page, refer to the access guide for data access operation.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/995ea7ede81b44e2b9ccca3e89b938fa~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


<span id="47319274"></span>
# Follow\-up: Browse and analyze data \- Analyst

Once the data access is complete, you can start browsing and analyzing the data uploaded by the app.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/82583c282fa14354b34603e0d3ccf927~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

Growth Analytics provides Kanban and rich out\-of\-the\-box analytics capabilities to help you and your team gain insights into the users, behaviors, and content of your application, see the Data Analytics and Governance Handbook for details：


* [Dashboard Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Dashboard_Overview)Mainly used for daily monitoring of product market data, you can directly use the system's preset Kanban, or create custom Kanban according to individual or team needs;

* Analysis functions, commonly used include:

   * [Event Analysis](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Event_Analysis)Statistical application user behavior and support for flexible dimensional filtering or segmentation.

   * [Funnel Analysis](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Funnel_Analysis) Funnel analysis is mainly used to analyze the conversion of users in the process.

   * [Retention Analysis](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Retention_Analysis): Used to analyze users returning to the product after starting (adding or using the product) for a period of time.

   * [Cohorts (User Grouping)](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Cohorts_User_Grouping): Analysis tool for user segmentation, you can carry out user , fine analysis, accurate touch and other work based on the segmented user group;

   * [User Details](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/User_Details): Used to analyze individual user details and behavior streams.
